description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Peter writes to God's chosen people scattered in exile, who have been born again into a living hope and rejoice even in trials. The prophets searched for this salvation; believers are to be holy, ransomed by the precious blood of Jesus and born of the word that lasts forever.
1.sw: Petro anawaandikia watu waliochaguliwa na Mungu waliotawanyika uhamishoni, ambao wamezaliwa upya katika tumaini lililo hai na wanafurahi hata katika majaribu. Manabii waliutafuta wokovu huu; waamini wanapaswa kuwa watakatifu, wakiwa wamekombolewa kwa damu ya thamani ya Yesu na kuzaliwa kwa neno linalodumu milele.
1.am: ጴጥሮስ በስደት ተበትነው ለሚኖሩ፣ ለሕያው ተስፋ ዳግመኛ ለተወለዱና በፈተናም ውስጥ ደስ ለሚላቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ምርጦች ይጽፋል። ነቢያት ይህን መዳን መረመሩ፤ አማኞች በኢየሱስ ክቡር ደም የተዋጁና ለዘላለም በሚኖረው ቃል የተወለዱ ስለ ሆኑ ቅዱሳን ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል።

2.en: Like newborn babies believers should crave pure spiritual milk. Jesus is the living stone and they are God's own people; they must live good lives among those who do not know God, submit to human authority, and endure unjust suffering in the steps of Jesus.
2.sw: Kama watoto wachanga, waamini wanapaswa kutamani maziwa safi ya kiroho. Yesu ni jiwe lililo hai nao ni watu wa Mungu mwenyewe; lazima waishi maisha mema kati ya wale wasiomjua Mungu, kutii mamlaka za kibinadamu, na kuvumilia mateso yasiyo ya haki wakifuata nyayo za Yesu.
2.am: አማኞች እንደ አራስ ሕፃናት ንጹሑን መንፈሳዊ ወተት ሊመኙ ይገባቸዋል። ኢየሱስ ሕያው ድንጋይ ነው፤ እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔር የራሱ ሕዝብ ናቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርን በማያውቁ መካከል መልካም ሕይወት ሊኖሩ፣ ለሰው ሥልጣን ሊገዙና የኢየሱስን ፈለግ ተከትለው ያለ አግባብ የሚደርስባቸውን መከራ ሊታገሡ ይገባቸዋል።

3.en: Peter instructs wives and husbands and urges all to repay insult with blessing. It is better to suffer for doing good than for doing evil, as Jesus suffered once for sins.
3.sw: Petro anawapa maagizo wake na waume na kuwahimiza wote walipe matusi kwa baraka. Ni afadhali kuteseka kwa kutenda mema kuliko kwa kutenda mabaya, kama Yesu alivyoteseka mara moja kwa ajili ya dhambi.
3.am: ጴጥሮስ ለሚስቶችና ለባሎች መመሪያ ይሰጣል፤ ሁሉም ስድብን በበረከት እንዲመልሱ ያሳስባል። ኢየሱስ ስለ ኃጢአት አንድ ጊዜ መከራን እንደ ተቀበለ ሁሉ ክፉ በማድረግ ሳይሆን መልካም በማድረግ መከራ መቀበል ይሻላል።

4.en: Believers are to live for the will of God, not for human desires, and to be good managers of God's grace. They should not be surprised by suffering, and whoever suffers as a Christian should not be ashamed.
4.sw: Waamini wanapaswa kuishi kwa ajili ya mapenzi ya Mungu, si kwa ajili ya tamaa za kibinadamu, na kuwa mawakili wema wa neema ya Mungu. Hawapaswi kushangazwa na mateso, na yeyote anayeteseka kama Mkristo asione aibu.
4.am: አማኞች ለሰው ምኞት ሳይሆን ለእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ሊኖሩና የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ መልካም መጋቢዎች ሊሆኑ ይገባቸዋል። በመከራ ሊደነቁ አይገባም፤ ክርስቲያን በመሆኑ መከራን የሚቀበልም አያፍርበት።

5.en: Peter urges the elders to shepherd God's flock willingly, and all to be humble under God's hand and resist the devil. He closes with final greetings.
5.sw: Petro anawahimiza wazee walichunge kundi la Mungu kwa hiari, na wote wanyenyekee chini ya mkono wa Mungu na kumpinga Ibilisi. Anamalizia kwa salamu za mwisho.
5.am: ጴጥሮስ ሽማግሌዎች የእግዚአብሔርን መንጋ በፈቃደኝነት እንዲጠብቁ፣ ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ በታች ራሳቸውን እንዲያዋርዱና ዲያብሎስን እንዲቃወሙ ያሳስባል። በመጨረሻ ሰላምታም ይደመድማል።
